== Style pass (2026-10-15) ==
=== Missing data ===
* No decklists for [[Alex Prodoehl]], [[Adam Bott]] or the four play-in players; deck cells left blank (were "—").
* Removed section "Missing from the GEMP zip / PC list" (text kept here):
** No GEMP import file in <code>2026 Gempc.zip</code>: [[Matt Wadden]] (Challonge seed 29, finished #28). PC listed Court / Luke Saga for him with no attached list.
** Play-in (Round 1) on Challonge, not on the PC published R64 and not in the zip: Vivik Kembaiyan (seed 62), Sean Hensley (65), Norman Hall (66), Joe Hosking (68). Adam Bott (seed 63) won a play-in then lost Round of 64; no zip file.
** On Challonge Round of 64, not in the PC seed list: [[Alex Prodoehl]] (seed 51, finished #51). He also played the 2026 Retro GEMPC (#12).
** Name: [[Charles Hickey]] (GEMP teacher). Challonge listed him as "Charless Hickey"; the Retro GEMPC table used Charlie.
** Challonge scores are often 0–0 (result entered without game count). YouTube scores are not copied unless on the bracket.
=== Possibly faulty data ===
* Challonge still showed the Finals match as open (progress 98%) when captured. Johnson is recorded as champion from the PC Top 8 list, the championship YouTube matches, and a reconstruction of the bracket working back from him. Sources: [https://challonge.com/18vokbxb Challonge 18vokbxb]; [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-06-tenth-annual-gempc-may-to-july-2026/ PC results].
* Finish numbers are reconstructed from the Challonge single-elimination bracket; the PC article listed the Round of 64 by seed, not by finish.
* [[Amar Banger]] and [[Robbie Hendon]] Light lists start with the interrupt [[Let The Wookiee Win (V)]] (PC labeled LTWW(V)), not an Objective. Inference: Banger's starting location is [[Naboo: Boss Nass' Chambers]] (exactly two [Light]; Kashyyyk is deployed by the interrupt). Hendon's start is [[Kashyyyk: Chewie's Hut]] (that site deploys only as a starting location).
=== Marginal cuts ===
* Lead: "The Players Committee results page is dated 4 July 2026 (updated 16 July 2026)." Source: PC results page.
* Lead: "Johnson also finished #17 at the [[2026 Retro GEMP Match Play Championship (Premiere to DSII)]]." (Already in the Also played Retro GEMPC table.)
* Results note: "Johnson's R64 pair was Court Of The Vile Gangster / Watch Your Step" (now in the Round of 64 (Top 8 players) table).
